reviewNotes: Sam's complete nine-line schedule dialogue asset is translated directly from English. Clinic, family, Joja, music and marriage contexts retain his casual humor and all controls.

fall_11.000.source: I gotta go visit Uncle Doctor today... Great.$7
fall_11.000.translation: Trebuie să-l vizitez astăzi pe Unchiul Doctor... Grozav.$7

winter_17.000.source: Maybe if all else fails, I'll become a submarine captain. That might be cool.
winter_17.000.translation: Poate că, dacă toate celelalte planuri eșuează, mă fac căpitan de submarin. Ar putea fi grozav.

marriage_Fri.001.source: Sorry, honey. I'm trying to concentrate here... $7
marriage_Fri.001.translation: Scuze, iubire. Încerc să mă concentrez aici... $7

marriage_Mon.001.source: Vincent seems a little lonely without me around. I used to play with him a lot.
marriage_Mon.001.translation: Vincent pare puțin singur fără mine prin preajmă. Mă jucam mult cu el.

marriage_Fri.000.source: Don't tell my mom... but I really just came over for a free lunch.$h
marriage_Fri.000.translation: Să nu-i spui mamei... dar, de fapt, am venit doar pentru un prânz gratis.$h

fall_11.002.source: I just got out of the doctor's office. Completely healthy and vigorous, just as I expected.$h
fall_11.002.translation: Tocmai am ieșit din cabinetul medicului. Complet sănătos și viguros, exact cum mă așteptam.$h

marriage_Mon.000.source: Mom seems okay. A little overworked, maybe.
marriage_Mon.000.translation: Mama pare bine. Poate puțin surmenată.

fall_11.001.source: I'm a healthy boy, doc. Can I go now? This is boring.
fall_11.001.translation: Sunt un băiat sănătos, doctore. Pot să plec acum? Este plictisitor.

rain2.000.source: Nothing like an ice cold Joja Cola on a sopping wet day, huh?#$e#Just kidding. Hehehe.$h
rain2.000.translation: Nimic nu se compară cu o Joja Cola rece ca gheața într-o zi udă leoarcă, nu?#$e#Glumesc. Hehehe.$h
